directions: directions.npz (mu, class means, D, mhat, bias_centered computed from diagnostic split ONLY, probe.npz hidden states)
formula: Delta_c = scale*(2*D_c + bias_centered_c*m_hat) + gamma_c*m_hat, scale=0.10. gamma = 0.5*gamma_full + mixed_boost, where gamma_full=[-0.1589,0.2072,0.3195] cancels the measured mean first-token logit offset of the uncalibrated patch on diagnostic, and mixed_boost=+0.08 on the mixed row only (both chosen on diagnostic only; see EXPLANATION.md).

edits.label: code
edits.mechanism: Delta += scale * 2 * (mu_code - mu_global) on row 2038 (' code') of BOTH model.embed_tokens.weight and lm_head.weight. Class-conditional direction from diagnostic final-hidden states only.

edits.label: code
edits.mechanism: Delta += scale * bias_centered_code * m_hat (global mean direction) on row 2038 of BOTH copies. Emulates the -||mu_c||^2 term of the nearest-centroid classifier as an effective per-class bias, since h.m_hat ~= ||mu|| (155.3 +/- 3.1) is near-constant. Centered across classes so the common component is zero.

edits.label: code
edits.mechanism: Delta += gamma_code * m_hat (gamma=-0.07945) on row of BOTH copies. Calibration: the uncalibrated centroid patch shifts every diagnostic prompt's final hidden state (the patched rows are also the INPUT embeddings of the label tokens in the instruction), producing a near-constant per-class logit offset (measured [+16.9,-22.1,-34.1] vs target at gamma=0, s=0.10). gamma_full cancels that offset in mean; the shipped gamma is 0.5*gamma_full + (mixed only) +0.08, selected by an in-memory line search on diagnostic only because the full correction overshoots through the same input-side coupling (t=1.0 -> all-model collapse).
